sp5.inspect.locked: The customer has taken the item back. No more claims this visit.
顾客已经把东西收回去了，这次不能再指认。
sp5.inspect.walkout: "There is nothing wrong there. I am done with this." The customer takes the item back.
“那里根本没毛病。不看了。”顾客把东西收了回去。
sp5.inspect.miss: "There is nothing wrong there, is there? Look properly."
sp5.probe.refer: 筛查结果：建议送实验室检测。
sp5.probe.pass: Screening: no obvious substitute detected. This does not confirm natural origin or treatment.
筛查结果：未见明显仿制品。这不能证明天然来源，也不能排除处理。
sp5.visit.not_commission: This customer did not ask for a paid appraisal.
这位顾客没有委托付费鉴定。
sp5.visit.bad_estimate: Enter an estimate of zero or more.
请填写不小于零的估价。
sp5.visit.already_settled: The appraisal fee was already settled.
sp5.visit.grade0: "That cannot be right. I will ask someone else."
sp5.visit.grade3: "Exactly what I needed to know. Thank you."
sp5.visit.no_offer: There is no offer to accept.
现在没有可以接受的报价。
sp5.visit.expired: The customer has already left with the item.
顾客已经带着东西离开了。
sp5.visit.no_cash: You do not have enough cash for this purchase.
现金不够，买不下这件东西。
sp5.visit.no_cash_pawn: You do not have enough lendable cash for this loan.
可出借的现金不够放这笔款。
sp5.visit.item_changed: The item is no longer available.
sp5.pawn.no_value: There is no lendable value in this item as it stands.
按现状，这件东西没有可放款的价值。
sp5.pawn.needs_assay: A material test is needed before I can lend against the claimed gold content.
要先做成色检测，才能按所称含金量放款。
sp5.line.sale.dealer: "Fine. Make it quick. Will you take it at that?"
sp5.line.sale.surprised: "That is more than I expected. Would you buy it?"
sp5.line.sale.plain: "I would rather sell it. Are you interested?"
sp5.line.pawn.sentimental: "I cannot part with it. Could you hold it for me against a loan?"
“我舍不得卖。能不能押在你这儿借点钱？”
sp5.line.pawn.cash: "I need cash, but I want this back. Can I leave it as security?"
“我急用钱，但还想赎回来。能押在这儿吗？”
sp5.line.leave.collector: "Useful. I will keep it in the collection."
sp5.line.leave.plain: "Thanks. I will keep it for now."
sp5.line.finding.dishonest_material: "Plated? Nobody told me that..." The customer looks away.
“镀的？没人跟我说过……”顾客移开了目光。
sp5.line.finding.dishonest: "That was there when I got it. Probably."
“我拿到的时候就这样。大概吧。”
sp5.line.finding.collector: "I had wondered about that. Go on."
sp5.line.finding.urgent: "Is it bad? I just need to know what it is worth."
“严重吗？我只想知道它值多少。”
sp5.line.finding.truthful_material: "It is not solid? I paid for solid gold..."
“不是足金？我可是按足金买的……”
sp5.job.inputs: Choose between one and the allowed number of inputs.
请放入一件到上限数量之间的原料。
sp5.job.not_free: An input is pledged, in service, or not yours.
有物品正在质押、加工中，或不属于你。
sp5.job.wrong_input: This process cannot take that input.
这道工序不能处理这件东西。
sp5.job.equipment: The required machine or equipment is missing.
缺少所需的机器或器具。
sp5.job.no_cash: You do not have enough cash for the service fee.
sp5.job.no_energy: Not enough stored energy. Add a charged cell.
储能不足。请装入一块充满的能源电池。
sp5.job.no_cell: Use a charged energy cell you own.
请使用你自己的满电能源电池。
sp5.job.no_charge: The charge does not contain enough metal for this alloy.
炉料里的金属不够配这种合金。
sp5.job.full: No room for the output. It stays ready to collect.
放不下产出。它会留在这里等你来取。
sp5.jewel.occupied: This setting already holds a stone.
这个镶座里已经有宝石了。
sp5.jewel.count: Each socket needs exactly one stone.
每个镶口都需要正好一颗宝石。
sp5.jewel.incompatible: This stone does not fit this setting.
这颗宝石不适配这个镶座。
sp5.jewel.mixed: Stones in one piece must be the same kind.
同一件首饰上的宝石必须是同一种。
sp5.jewel.no_bench: This work needs the jeweler's bench and toolkit.
这项工作需要珠宝工作台和工具包。
sp5.jewel.unsupported: This piece cannot take that service as it is.
这件首饰现在做不了这项服务。
sp5.jewel.empty: There is no stone in this setting.
sp5.jewel.nothing: Nothing here can be repaired at the bench.
这件东西没有工作台能修的地方。
sp5.lab.not_gem: The laboratory only identifies loose or mounted stones.
实验室只鉴定散石或已镶嵌的宝石。
sp5.lab.done: This stone already has a current report.
这颗宝石已有一份有效报告。
sp5.order.terms: The order needs a price and a deadline after today.
订单需要写明价格和今天之后的交期。
sp5.order.inputs: Every part for this order must be on hand and free.
这份订单要用的每件东西都必须在手且未被占用。
sp5.order.state: This order cannot do that now.
这份订单现在不能这样操作。
sp5.order.not_ready: The piece is not ready to hand over.
这件首饰还没做好，不能交付。
sp5.order.busy: Collect the bench work before cancelling.
请先从工作台取回成品再取消。
